description: Finds the building at a German address in our 3D building data. Returns the building at the address first, then nearby buildings, each with a building_ref for start_order and a short German description (type, storeys, footprint). If several addresses match, returns them instead: ask the user which one is meant. Where the address may be one of several buildings (semi-detached or terraced houses, several buildings on one plot), ask the user which is theirs. Changes nothing.

address.description: street, house number, postcode and city, e.g. 'Buschkamp 12, 48161 Münster'

name: find_building

building_ref.description: pass this to start_order as it is

title: Find the building
